title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Visit Programme by Tier
content:
## Schedule of included visits

Each tier of the Preventive Maintenance Agreements carries a fixed programme of scheduled visits per agreement year. The schedule below is the published content of that programme and is read by tier; every figure is per agreement year unless the column says otherwise.

| Tier | Full preventive maintenance visits | Inspection-only visits | Filter and belt change visits | Drive belts replaced during a visit included in the price | Condenser and evaporator coil cleanings | Spring start-up and fall shutdown visits | Filter grade supplied on filter change visits (MERV rating) | Price of one additional visit beyond the entitlement (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | 0 | 0 | 4 | included | 0 | not included | 8 | 210 |
| Inspection Agreement | 0 | 2 | 0 | not included | 0 | not included | 8 | 260 |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | 4 | 0 | 4 | included | 1 | included | 8 | 340 |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | 4 | 0 | 4 | included | 2 | included | 11 | 340 |
| Full Coverage Agreement | 4 | 0 | 6 | included | 2 | included | 11 | 340 |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | 6 | 0 | 12 | included | 2 | included | 13 | 340 |

### Reading the schedule

- The number of full preventive maintenance visits, inspection-only visits and filter and belt change visits are three separate columns; a tier's visit programme is the three read together, and a tier with a zero in a column includes no visit of that kind.
- Whether drive belts replaced during a visit are included in the price is a per-tier switch; at the Inspection Agreement they are not.
- Coil cleanings are counted as visits of their own kind: none at the two entry tiers, one at the Preventive Maintenance Agreement, two at each tier above it.
- The seasonal start-up and shutdown visits are a switch: not included at the Filter & Belt Service Plan or the Inspection Agreement, included from the Preventive Maintenance Agreement upward.
- The filter grade is the MERV rating supplied on filter change visits: 8 at the three lower tiers, 11 at the Labor Coverage Agreement and the Full Coverage Agreement, 13 at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.
- The price of one additional visit beyond the entitlement is the figure in the last column: 210 USD at the Filter & Belt Service Plan, 260 USD at the Inspection Agreement, and 340 USD at every tier from the Preventive Maintenance Agreement upward.

### Tier comparison at a glance

A building owner comparing the Preventive Maintenance Agreement with the Full Coverage Agreement sees the same four full preventive visits and the same additional visit price of 340 USD, but six rather than four filter and belt change visits, two rather than one coil cleaning, and MERV 11 rather than MERV 8 filters. The Comprehensive Performance Agreement is the only tier with six full preventive visits and twelve filter and belt change visits.
